## Workload

Hannah Lowe completed 491 reads during the review period. The work required 270 hours, giving an average rate of 1.8 reads per hour. This provides a summary of the grader’s activity and indicates the volume of work completed during the period. The workload information was considered as part of the overall review and provides context for the quality findings.

## Quality

A sample of 45 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 46.7. This result was recorded for consideration alongside the workload information. The review provides a concise assessment of the work completed and the level of agreement identified in the checked sample.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. Hannah Lowe and Priya Anand considered the findings together and agreed to keep the current session pattern.
